name: JFrog Artifactory API Key
description: A per-user Artifactory secret that predates access tokens and that JFrog documents as deprecated from Artifactory 7.47.x.

blockers.summary: Two JFrog pages show different key forms (AKCp plus 69 alphanumerics versus a 44-character unprefixed example); none says which applies to which release.
No page names a release or date at which authentication with an existing API key stops unconditionally.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
